title: End-to-End Process
subtitle: Execute the required supply chain and manufacturing flow in the correct sequence.
success: Data saved successfully. Latest data has been refreshed.
actionSuccess: Process updated successfully. Latest data has been refreshed.

purchase-requisition.title: Purchase Requisition
purchase-requisition.desc: Create and submit material demand before purchasing.

purchase-order.title: Purchase Order
purchase-order.desc: Convert approved demand into a supplier order.

incoming-quality.title: Incoming Quality Check
incoming-quality.desc: Inspect received batches. Only released stock becomes available.

production-order.title: Production Order
production-order.desc: Plan finished goods quantity and release work to production.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Process
manufacturing.desc: Start and complete released production orders.

finished-goods-receipt.title: Finished Goods Receipt
finished-goods-receipt.desc: Receive completed production into the FG warehouse.

sales-order.title: Sales / Delivery Order
sales-order.desc: Confirm customer demand and reserve released finished goods.

customer-delivery.title: Customer Delivery
customer-delivery.desc: Post delivery, consume reservation, and reduce physical stock.
